soundness_flags.label: ass:residual-nondegeneracy
soundness_flags.one_line: The cited LiDing2020ReMRegression Condition 1 does not impose the proposal's positive lower bound on the outcome-sum projection residual variance, so this custom normalization condition cannot be tagged standard under that citation; retag it novel and justify its design relevance.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The article defines immediate-stop PSRR, proves unbiasedness and a variance-reduction bound, and states that asymptotic distributions of common statistics under the nonuniform PSRR assignment law are left to future work.
The preprint derives a negative-power stationary law and then applies a rejection correction that produces a uniform acceptable-set draw, rather than analyzing original immediate first entry.

Condition 1 requires limiting treatment fractions, convergence of listed finite-population covariances with nonsingular covariate covariance, and maximal-term conditions; it does not state a positive lower bound on the residual variance of Y(1)+Y(0) after projection on X.
The article develops closed-form Fisher-randomization-test-inversion confidence intervals for an ANCOVA statistic and gives an observed-data sufficient condition for coverage.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The cited work concerns uniform Mahalanobis rerandomization and its Gaussian-plus-truncated-Gaussian asymptotic law.
The article develops Gaussian prepivoting for finite-population causal inference and weak-null asymptotic validity under rerandomized designs.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Retag ass:residual-nondegeneracy as novel and give a concrete applicability justification, or replace it with a literature-supported nondegenerate-variance condition while retaining a separate treatment of the degenerate residual case.

Add a worked finite-population example computing the first-entry allocation, its boundary component, and the proposed envelope critical value; this will make the claimed clipped-law object auditable before the diffusion proof is completed.

State a direct finite-dimensional contrast against both uniform Mahalanobis rerandomization and stationary/corrected PSRR, such as a boundary-mass or variance functional that separates all three output laws.
